$comment: FORM P4-T4 retroactive admission record (the slot predates the budget, so it is also in baselineSlots; this record documents why it earned its place). Written after REG-339 closed on 2026-11-17: before that the probe was a known failure and the typed REST controller was still emitted, so `enforced` would have been false.

declarative.why: says a concept is platform state, not app data; no ordering, no logic

notLower.why: withholding every REST, menu, export and agent surface of a concept is decided by the generator and runtime; no expression or flow can remove a route the platform emits

taught.bundleLine: A concept marked "system":true (the identity pack's credentials and sessions) gets no REST route, menu, export or agent tool; a concept of yours that holds a password hash is refused.
